# JHB Curtain Cleaning

> Johannesburg's specialist on-site curtain and drapery restoration service. Cleaned hanging on tracks with zero fabric shrinkage and zero room downtime.

## Core Specializations
- **On-Site In-Situ Cleaning:** We clean all drapes, sheers, motorized tracks, pelmets, and double-volume curtains while hanging on their original tracks. No taking down, no unhooking, zero fabric shrinkage.
- **Commercial & Hospitality Protocol:** 24 guest suites cleaned between 10:00 and 14:00 checkout/check-in turnover with zero room downtime and SANS 1423 Fire Retardancy certification.
- **10% Trade Partner Program:** 10% recurring EFT referral commission for interior decorators and curtain manufacturing workrooms.
- **Highveld Dust Storm Restoration:** Low-moisture extraction removing fine winter silica dust, soot, and allergens from linings and pleats.

## Geographic Coverage (Gauteng, South Africa)
- **Sandton Hub:** Sandhurst, Bryanston, Hyde Park, Morningside, Inanda, Atholl, Riverclub, Sandown.
- **Northern Suburbs:** Rosebank, Houghton, Saxonwold, Melrose, Parkhurst, Craighall Park.
- **Midrand & Estates:** Waterfall Estate, Dainfern, Steyn City, Fourways Gardens, Helderfontein.
- **Pretoria East:** Waterkloof, Silver Lakes, Menlyn, Woodhill, Faerie Glen.

## Technical Knowledge Guides
- [Highveld Dust Season Curtain Care](https://www.jhbcurtaincleaning.co.za/guides/highveld-dust-season-curtain-care): How dry winter dust storms damage linings and how low-moisture extraction restores them.
- [Zero Shrinkage Methodology](https://www.jhbcurtaincleaning.co.za/guides/zero-shrinkage-curtain-cleaning): Why off-site immersion shrinkage occurs and how on-site micro-misting prevents dimensional distortion.
- [Commercial Hotel Drapery Protocol](https://www.jhbcurtaincleaning.co.za/guides/commercial-hotel-curtain-hygiene): Zero room downtime procedures and SANS 1423 flame retardancy standards.
- [Velvet & Silk Restoration](https://www.jhbcurtaincleaning.co.za/guides/velvet-silk-curtain-restoration): pH-neutral botanical care for delicate natural fibers.
- [Double-Volume 5.5m Drops](https://www.jhbcurtaincleaning.co.za/guides/double-volume-curtain-cleaning): Scaffold-free specialized extension care for architectural window installations.
